s.note: Butch and Etta on the bicycle in the morning
s.how: Split 2 baguettes lengthways and cut each in half. Spread with salted butter and wholegrain mustard. Layer with 250g leg ham, 150g sliced sharp cheddar, 1 thinly sliced green apple and halved cornichons. Press closed, wrap tightly in baking paper and tie with string.

s.note: the safe they blow with far too much dynamite
s.how: Melt 200g red candy melts. Dip 20 pretzel rods two-thirds of the way and push a short piece of liquorice strap into the top of each as a fuse. Set on baking paper for 20 minutes.

m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 4 soaked and blitzed dried chillies, 2 tsp cumin, 3 garlic cloves and a tin of tomatoes. Braise 3 hours. Bake cornbread from 150g cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and egg alongside.

w.note: the bicycle ride with the song playing
w.how: Beat 175g butter with 175g sugar, add 3 eggs and lemon zest, and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 45 minutes. Soak with hot lemon syrup, then top with 100g icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.

d.note: who are those guys? one more before Bolivia
d.how: For each drink, dry shake 50ml bourbon, 25ml lemon juice, 15ml sugar syrup and half an egg white for 10 seconds, then add ice and shake hard for 15 seconds. Strain into a glass over ice. Shake 2 drops of aromatic bitters onto the foam and add a cherry.
